title: PlayStation.com pages for Ghost of Yotei and Until Dawn 2 now carry a 'PlayStation Exclusive' badge

sources.name: PlayStation.com (UAE) page of Ghost of Yotei, badge read 7 Nov 16:30Z
PlayStation.com (UAE) page of Until Dawn 2, badge read 7 Nov 16:40Z
Push Square, 7 Nov 15:30Z: spotted by a user, no statement from Sony

first_report: A user spotted it; Push Square 7 Nov 2026 15:30Z (19:30 Dubai); read on the live PlayStation.com pages at 16:30Z
footage: stills: the PlayStation.com page videos are 5 and 10 second dark ambient loops (Ghost of Yotei mask loop 1920x814 at 5.1 s, Until Dawn 2 hero loop 2560x956 at 9.9 s), too short and too dark to carry a Reel; IGN and Sony trailer files not reachable (IGN page 403 earlier, YouTube sign-in); the evidence of this story is the page itself, so the Reel shows the live pages and their key art captured at 2x

claims.text: The UAE PlayStation.com pages of Ghost of Yotei Complete Edition and Until Dawn 2 show a 'PlayStation Exclusive*' badge next to the title
claims.status: read on the live pages (screenshots at 16:30Z and 16:40Z)

claims.text: A user spotted it first; Sony has made no announcement about it
claims.status: Push Square; no Sony statement found

claims.text: Sony 'doubling down' on exclusivity, poor PC sales
claims.status: Push Square opinion and allegation; not used

angle.hook: The word 'Exclusive' is back on PlayStation's own game pages
angle.why_now: Spotted today on two big first-party pages
angle.players_here: The badge shows on the UAE pages, which a Gulf reader can open now
angle.payoff: Sony has not said what it means; the pages are the evidence
